input.summary: Add exclusive New York County court venue to the Choice of Law clause
input.comment: [Playbook] The clause picks New York law but names no forum, so we have added exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County, consistent with our preferred governing law and venue position. The New York law sentence is left untouched.

ops.text: The state and federal courts located in New York County, New York will have exclusive jurisdiction over any dispute arising out of or related to this Agreement, except that either party may seek temporary injunctive relief in any court of competent jurisdiction.
